Definition: from G4444; fortified; Pergamus, a place in Asia Minor:--Pergamos.
BiblicalUsage: Pergamos was one of the seven churches of Asia, named in the letter John was told to write. To the angel of the church in Pergamos the Lord speaks as He who has the sharp sword with two edges.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that the sharp sword is the Lord's answer to a church under pressure: He speaks with authority because He is the one who judges, and His word cuts to the truth.
